sc.environment=g.environment CROSS JOIN clock WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment} AND g.state IN ('ACTIVE','PENDING') AND g.valid_from <=clock.at AND g.valid_to >clock.at AND (g.source_type IN ('DIRECT','OA_REQUEST') OR (g.source_type='GROUP' AND dg.active AND src.environment=g.environment AND NOT src.quarantined AND u.id=m.principal_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_group_member gm ON gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND gm.membership_id=m.id AND gm.generation=m.generation AND gm.current CROSS JOIN clock WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND m.valid_from <=clock.at AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock.at) AND ((g.source_type IN ('DIRECT','OA_REQUEST') AND g.membership_id=m.id AND g.generation=m.generation) OR (g.source_type='GROUP' AND gm.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(gm.periods) assignment WHERE (assignment->>'valid_from')::date <=(clock.at AT TIME ZONE g.business_zone)::date AND (assignment->>'valid_to' IS NULL OR (assignment->>'valid_to')::date >(clock.at AT TIME ZONE g.business_zone)::date)))) ), eligible_grants AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT g.* FROM grants g WHERE g.source_type='GROUP' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recipients r WHERE r.grant_id=g.id) ), policies AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p.* FROM auth_governance.request_policy p JOIN roles r ON r.id=p.role_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND p.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND
